Name 
Elizabeth Revestimentos
What We Do 
More than 38 years of tradition in ceramic coverings. Recently integrated into the Mohawk Group, world leader in finishes, it is the largest producer of ceramic tiles by revenue in Brazil, combined with Eliane Revestimentos. It has an installed manufacturing capacity of more than 4.3 million m²/month. Of these, two million are porcelain tiles. With four manufacturing units, two in Paraíba, one in Santa ​Catarina and another in Rio Grande do Norte, Elizabeth​ products follow strict quality standards. Today, combined with the operations of Eliane.

<http://www.ceramicaelizabeth.com.br/en/>

## About Elizabeth Revestimentos
Elizabeth Revestimentos provides a variety of floors, porcelain, and ceramic tiles for indoor and outdoor environments, walls, bedrooms, kitchens, living rooms, and many others. It also gives its customers of choice from a range of products. The company was founded in 1984 and is based in Joao Pessoa. In November 2022, Elizabeth Revestimentos was acquired by Mohawk Industries. The terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
